author: Disney
description:
Movie Surfers is back with Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu. Host Michelle Khare (@MichelleKhare) goes behind the scenes with the filmmakers and creative teams bringing Mando and Grogu to the big screen, exploring incredible props, creatures, and movie magic. Watch the full episode now for the complete journey inside this epic Star Wars adventure.
